label: D1 after a reward, late in episode / low value, not strongly committed to a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 steps where the reward input is 1 (100% of activations; never on GO, D2, or unrewarded/penalty D1). Within rewarded D1 (13.5% rate) it is gated by the model state: strongly concentrated late in the episode (none before trial ~20, 96% of mass in trials 50-99, rate rising to 10% at trials 90-99), by low value-head output (no activity above value ~7.6) and by a policy logit that is not strongly pro-a1 (choice < 2.78; nothing at strongly-a1 or strongly-a2 extremes). Activation often builds over consecutive rewarded D1s. Predicate uses only observed input plus model internals (value, choice); no future variables. Precision is moderate (~0.45): many rewarded late low-value D1s stay silent, so the exact gating is not captured. Magnitude is tiny in absolute terms (max 0.011).
